description: while: {mode: cel, expr: "1 == true"} / "1.0 == 1" / "'a' == 1" -- the same heterogeneous-equality comparisons as c7-if-*, this time via a while loop's own condition (electricity/docs/spec/runtime-semantics.md §4.3): the two numeric-family comparisons let the loop run its one gated pass, the non-numeric cross-type comparison never does. This is the 'while' half of C7 that the 'if' cases (c7-if-*) deferred to lane H.
